name: hyperframes
description: Pinned local HTML-to-video renderer; bounded invocation via vrooli host hyperframes
installHint: vrooli host install hyperframes delegates the SDA frozen host-tool gateway; no browser download

storage.rationale: Managed versioned frozen dependency trees; film bundles belong to the caller.

notes: The explicit hyperframes tool name is required; this is not an alternative FFmpeg implementation. Exact0.8.112 Linux amd64 four-video render/reuse/deadline observed on one host; historical0.8.44 receipts and immutable installation preserved. Linux remains experimental; broader portability is unqualified.
